entries.quote: He experienced response to erlotinib for 10 months
entries.cited_text: This report describes a patient with chemotherapy-refractory metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) whose tumor was characterized by an activating mutation in exon 19 of the epidermal growth factor receptor ( EGFR ). He experienced response to erlotinib for 10 months, and then developed disease progression in association with emergence of the T790M mutation.
